name: NLA.SP15.coefficient_determinant_identity
header:
theorem coefficient_determinant_identity (x : Parameters) (u s : ℂ) :
    coefficientDeterminant x u s =
      u ^ 3 + ∑ i : Fin 9, (coefficients x i : ℂ) * coefficientMonomials u s i

name: NLA.SP15.coefficient_strict_derivative
header:
theorem coefficient_strict_derivative :
    HasStrictFDerivAt coefficients coefficientDerivative basePoint
